svg.title: The timing correction changes the full distribution

cc:Work.dc:title: The timing correction changes the full distribution
cc:Work.dc:description: Every selected case contributes to these empirical cumulative distributions. The displayed x axis is a zoom in minutes; y is a sample percentage. The original program emits C-minus-A and corrected versions C-minus-B. Strict below-five-minute counts include negative values and use differing denominators.

g.text: Display window: −5 to 30 minutes. All cases count, including negatives and gaps beyond this window.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #374151

g.text: Lines use “at or below”; the reported counts use strict <5 minutes. Each version selects a different sample.

g.text: Published output measures A→C; corrected outputs measure B→C. These are miner-supplied header times.
